tools.name: sentinel_list_projects
tools.description: List security projects visible to the authenticated tenant, including asset and open finding counts. (Required token scope: read_assets)

tools.name: sentinel_list_assets
tools.description: List tenant assets with domain ownership verification status, target type, and open finding counts. (Required token scope: read_assets)

tools.name: sentinel_get_asset_surface
tools.description: Retrieve discovered HTTP Site Map tree, endpoints, and fingerprinted Technology Stack + CVE alerts for a tenant asset. (Required token scope: read_assets)

tools.name: sentinel_list_findings
tools.description: Query normalized security findings across the tenant with optional filters by project, asset, severity, status, or keyword. (Required token scope: read_findings)

tools.name: sentinel_get_finding_detail
tools.description: Fetch full technical detail, normalized evidence, proof level, CVSS/CWE metadata, and remediation guidance for one finding. (Required token scope: read_findings)

tools.name: sentinel_get_vciso_posture
tools.description: Return truthful Virtual CISO security posture metrics: open severity distribution, verified asset ratio, SLA aging, and top remediation priorities. (Required token scope: read_findings)

tools.name: sentinel_list_runs
tools.description: List historical and active security assessment runs visible to the tenant. (Required token scope: read_assets)

tools.name: sentinel_generate_report
tools.description: Generate a NorthBound Dossier report for a tenant project or asset as structured summary JSON, standalone HTML, or a PAdES + RFC 3161 signed PDF. (Required token scope: read_findings)

tools.name: sentinel_launch_assessment
tools.description: Launch a governed security assessment on a tenant domain/FQDN asset. Balanced and Active postures require verified domain ownership; unverified assets accept Passive posture only. tools.name: sentinel_get_assessment_status
tools.description: Poll live execution progress or completed run status for a security assessment scan_id or run_id. (Required token scope: read_assets or launch_scans)
